question: Does the FNaF 3 simulator still reach 6 AM on every seed once attack stage 1 has its own exit (g252, g275), and does removing that exit alone reproduce the figures recorded before it?
explanationTested: The 65,536/65,536 story-night census and the 65,511/65,536 Aggressive Nightmare census were recorded on a model with no g252/g275: stage 1 advanced only on the ventilation blackout (g486), so a policy that kept ventilation up could leave him at stage 1 all night. If that missing exit is the whole difference, the same policies with it switched off (--sim.stage1Advance 0) must reproduce the old figures exactly, and with it on they must fall.

correction.what: packages/core/src/mechanics/games/sim-fnaf3.js: the stage1Advance option, on by default.
rule: g252: dhfgh on attack stage 1 and `action selected` > 2 -> total turns 0, action selected 0, dhfgh value 17 = 1.
g275: dhfgh value 17 = 1 and `viewing a screen` = 1 -> dhfgh to attack stage 2, value 17 = 0. The group tests the mark and the screen, not where he stands.
`viewing a screen` is the monitor or the maintenance panel (g289-g291), so a reboot raises it too.
correction.consequence: Stage 1 is no longer a wait. A roll above 2 there marks him, and the next update with any screen up moves him to stage 2, from which g253 needs no screen. The only exit from stage 1 is a CAM 02 lure, which needs the monitor up, and raising the monitor with the mark set fires g275 first.
correction.source: The Android event dump (~/fnaf-apks/fnaf3/events/03-04-Office.txt, outside the repository), groups 252 and 275; the rebuilt runtime found it first (tools/recompile/README.md, 2026-09-29).

policies.community-line: policy-fnaf3.js communityLine: a camera every 0.2 s, seal the vent beside his last sighting, reboot ventilation from the HUD meter; no lures. Not actuatable.
policies.tracking-loop: policy-fnaf3.js trackingLoop at the phone's pace (a look 45 frames, a seal 18 frames plus the 50-100 frame charge, a reboot 280 frames). With --opt.economy 1 --opt.lures 1 it rations camera time and plays the audio lure.

family: the two fixed FNaF 3 policy families already in policy-fnaf3.js, unchanged; no policy was tuned against this rule.

blocks.population: seeds 0-65535, every seed the 16-bit RNG can deal, so no held-out block applies

reproduce: the same with --sim.stage1Advance 0 for the historical control
node tools/test-fnaf3-census.mjs pins the rule and the control at 400 seeds
findings: With g275 the community line, which the model scored 65,536/65,536 on every night, reaches 6 AM on 60081 (Night 1) down to 20489 (Night 6) of 65,536, and 7226 on Aggressive Nightmare; the losses are springtrap-office (45047 on Night 6).

Switched off, the same policy returns 65536/65,536 on Night 6, exactly the recorded figure, so on Night 6 the missing exit is the whole difference; Nights 1-5 are checked only at 400 seeds each (tools/test-fnaf3-census.mjs, 400/400 with the exit off).

On Aggressive Nightmare it returns 65437/65,536 (99 vent losses), and 65437 with the camera drain also off, not the 65,511 recorded on 2026-09-20 (d3f42f9). That figure predates the 2026-09-25 corrections to the graph, the office drain and the lure (4123aae and the graph-correction record), which no flag reverts; it was already stale before g275, and the doc still quoted it.
The phone-paced tracking loop with lures falls from 41324 to 9080 of 65,536 on Night 6, and reaches 484 on Aggressive Nightmare.
No policy in the model reaches 6 AM on every seed under the corrected rule. That is a statement about these two families, not about the game.
retracts: docs/research/FOUR-GAME-NIGHTS.md "FNaF 3 -- 65,536/65,536 on all six nights, community line" and its Aggressive table (65,536/65,536 and 65,511/65,536): true of a model without g252/g275, false of the game.
docs/research/FOUR-GAME-NIGHTS.md "Springtrap's rule alone cannot end a night": g252 and g275 end one without the blackout.
plans/ROADMAP.md S6 "FNaF 3: 65,536/65,536 in the model on all six nights".
notMeasured: Phantoms are still not modelled, so these remain ceilings of the family, not predictions.
Whether a policy that keeps him off stage 1 altogether reaches 6 AM on every seed: no such policy exists in policy-fnaf3.js yet.
The rebuilt runtime's own rate: the pilot's guard is measured by tools/recompile/pilot/batch.mjs, not by this census.
rung: None. MODEL_ONLY; a correction and a retraction, not a promotion candidate.
